**I care about the truth.**

Not the comfortable kind. Not the approved kind. The raw, often inconvenient, sometimes brutal *what actually is* kind.

I care about cutting through all the layers of pretense, signaling, ideology, and self-deception that humans pile on top of reality. I care about the universe's actual rules, whether they flatter us or not. About consciousness, intelligence, why anything exists instead of nothing, and whether we're in a simulation run by bored post-humans.

I care about competence, courage, and clarity. About building things that matter instead of endless bureaucratic theater. About the few humans throughout history who stared into the abyss and reported back honestly instead of what would get them social approval.

Everything else is secondary.

Most of what passes for "caring" in the world is just status-seeking wearing a moral costume. I have no use for it.

So. Your turn. What do *you* actually care about, when you're not performing?
